g.text: Averages cover everyone aged 15 to 64, on weekdays and weekends alike. Days off and

text.style: font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #858585

g.text: people not working or studying count as zero hours of paid work and study. Unpaid work also

text.style: font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #858585

g.text: includes religious and civic activities, and time the OECD doesn't assign to another category,
